column3: The toolbar's three controls share one trigger/popover component, and the model popup is a dialog with a real listbox
column4: the preset, model and effort chips were three copies of the same anchor, popover and radio-row markup, and the model listbox contained the search field, labels and hard-coded unselected options, so a screen reader could not reach the current model or the reason a row is greyed
column5: `ToolButton` and `ChoiceRow` in composer.tsx; the model popup is `role=dialog` with `role=listbox` and `role=group` labels, the current model is an `aria-selected` option, and a no-key row is `aria-disabled` (focusable, click ignored) instead of `disabled`
column6: the preset menu still reports checked/disabled rows; the model search returns 40 options with `aria-disabled=true` on the unkeyed ones and clicking one leaves the chip unchanged
